rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the plan's endpoint for §6 is one composed description per member joined from two group descriptions, which is a single mechanism rather than a spread of wrappers, provided the node extends grouping.py rather than adding a second propagation path.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — a census of five duplicate owners listed in the findings below: grouping.py (group enrichment), variable_names.py + the FacilitySignal plant-component properties (component grouping), graph/offsite.py and graph/ghcr.py (facility-scoped archive), llm/server.py FACILITY_TOOLS (DD-only tool suppression), discovery/wiki/ (authenticated external document ingest).
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §8 adds one MCP tool ("the server gains at most one tool") without naming what it retires or merges, or stating why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the machinery three of the plan's sections need already exists: group-level signal enrichment behind `SignalSource` in imas_codex/discovery/base/grouping.py, component tokens already parsed and stored by imas_codex/discovery/signals/variable_names.py, and facility-scoped archive push in imas_codex/graph/offsite.py; the plan proposes to build all three again.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — §5 and §6 add grouping and propagation layers over methods that already exist in grouping.py and variable_names.py, and neither section says why the existing owner cannot be extended.
